Lane counts, component selection, fallback labels, build shapes, permissions and tested-tree lookup remain unchanged. Several lanes lose memory headroom; head lines 153–154 explicitly acknowledge this. Resource pressure could cause CI failures, but supplied evidence does not show that failures bypass required tests or release qualification, so this is not a supported security finding.

The build guide patch (head lines 622–633 and 666–679) and changelog.d/ci-interim-job-sizes.md:3 document the same interim shapes and distinguish them from measured sizes. No executable provider change, new privilege, credential exposure, encryption change, authorization weakening or cache-policy change is present in this scope. In particular, A-011/A-017 and T-054 build-qualification concerns are not shown to regress, and T-041 cache isolation and at-rest mitigations are untouched.

Coverage is limited to supplied source, not unchanged workflow implementations or live deployment. Production shape-signing claims are documentation evidence, not independently verified policy. Integration should reconcile any supplied changes to scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py with this table and examine any changes to darkbloom-route.yml or provider-tests.yml for shape handling and failure propagation; their absence here is not evidence of a missing control.
